purpose: Preserves earlier Signature Events research. The current project is a draft concept and the Council fund requires evidence that an event has been delivered successfully for at least two years.

matches.fit_reason: This becomes a strong growth pathway only after the festival has been successfully staged for at least two years.
matches.eligibility_status: TO BE CONFIRMED: eligible legal entity, two-year event history, tourism impact, insurance and viable multi-year plan
evidence_needed: confirmed legal applicant and authority to apply
grant-specific eligible scope, budget and quotes
local need, delivery plan and measurable outcomes
site, cultural, rights, safety or partner permissions where relevant
matches.funding_ask: Up to $60,000 per year for one to three years
matches.cofunding_plan: This established-event growth layer can be combined with memberships, ticket or earned income where eligible, resident fundraising, local sponsor cash or in-kind support, visitor giving, philanthropy and later program grants. Every layer is unconfirmed until evidenced.
matches.qualifying_reframe: Build the track record, visitor evidence and operating model before seeking signature status.
matches.next_move: Use early event grants to establish the festival; use Signature funding only for proven growth and retention.
human_roles: Rights-owning producer, creative or broadcast lead
Cultural, editorial and financial reviewers appropriate to the work
ai_tasks: Maintain the official-source and eligibility checklist
Prepare the evidence register, budget worksheet and deadline brief for human review
Flag unsupported claims, missing authority, duplicated costs and source changes
matches.readiness_check: Create an event-history and visitation evidence register; do not apply without two successful stagings.

roles_needed: Rights-owning producer, creative or broadcast lead
Cultural, editorial and financial reviewers appropriate to the work
partner_pathways.boundary_note: The listed roles are planning needs. The island directory contains public research leads only; no organisation has been approached, approved or assigned to this project.
